description: Test file for Kubernetes kubelet lifecycle predicate functions, including resource validation, node affinity, taints, OS constraints, and feature gate behaviors.

methods.name: TestRemoveMissingExtendedResources
methods.description: Tests removal of missing extended resources from pods based on node allocatable resources and feature gate.

methods.name: makeTestPod
methods.description: Creates a test Pod with specified resource requests and limits.

methods.name: makeTestPodWithDRAResource
methods.description: Creates a test Pod with a specific DRA-backed extended resource request.

methods.name: emptyRequests
methods.description: Removes resource requests from all containers in a pod.

methods.name: makeTestNode
methods.description: Creates a test Node with specified allocatable resources.

methods.name: makeResources
methods.description: Generates a resource list with specified CPU, memory, pods, extended resource, storage, and huge pages.

methods.name: makeAllocatableResources
methods.description: Generates a resource list for node allocatable resources.

methods.name: newResourcePod
methods.description: Creates a pod with containers requesting specified resources.

methods.name: newPodWithPort
methods.description: Creates a pod with containers exposing specified host ports.

methods.name: TestGeneralPredicates
methods.description: Tests various predicate failure scenarios such as resource insufficiency, node name mismatch, port conflicts, taints/tolerations, and affinity.

methods.name: TestRejectPodAdmissionBasedOnOSSelector
methods.description: Tests pod admission rejection based on OS label selectors.

methods.name: TestRejectPodAdmissionBasedOnOSField
methods.description: Tests pod admission rejection based on OS field in pod spec.

methods.name: TestPodAdmissionBasedOnSupplementalGroupsPolicy
methods.description: Tests admission control based on supplemental groups policy feature gate and node features.
